goals.objective: Build an outline chapter-level evaluation for Alex. Prepare 25 diverse raw headers.md extractions sampled from ~/Documents/Alex3/assets into repository eval artifacts. Each case must contain input.md and a manually editable output.md annotation sidecar. Add a deterministic CLI eval that predicts chapter heading level with the production selector, validates annotations, reports exact-match accuracy and per-case results, and writes a run artifact. Do not change the production selector until manual gold annotations exist. Start a durable optimization loop that can resume after the user completes output.md annotations and then iterate toward the gold outputs. Preserve unrelated dirty-worktree changes.
